    The projective boundary almost-split morphism #

    For an indecomposable projective finitely generated module P, the inclusion rad P ⟶ P is minimal right almost split. The proof is a bounded adaptation of the relevant arguments in the donor's ProjectiveSimpleTop.lean, ProjectiveSimpleRank.lean, and ProjectiveBoundaryAlmostSplit.lean at commit d5ba0c48e7a851afd51247ff9cd81fc629e00ed2. Their unrelated simple-ranking and standard-semantics layers are not imported.
